{{dablink|For other uses of the word "road," see [[Road]].}}
The '''Lugard Road''' is a major highway linking the city of [[Lugard]] in [[Murandy]] to [[Caemlyn]], the capital of [[Andor]], although it is likely that other roads close to Lugard would also have the same name. It is a major trade artery and well-traveled by merchants.
